rule: Among the benchmarked variants, all scored with the selected post-processing on the unchanged validation split on the same RTX 3070, choose the smallest deployable file whose validation PQ_dataset is within 0.002 of the uncompressed teacher (seed-45 weights, mixed-precision inference). Ties: the faster end-to-end test pipeline. If no compressed variant qualifies, keep the teacher.
training_text: 12.4 min teacher training loop (20 epochs, RTX 5060 Ti) + 4.0 min fine-tuning after pruning (RTX 3070)
timing_text: 475 ms/image over 180 test images (476 ms excluding the first), RTX 3070
timing_scope: read + preprocess + transfer + model + components + RLE round-trip + CSV; optional probability export included; no warm-up excluded; model loading excluded
compression_conclusion: FP16 weights: PQ change -0.00001 at 47 vs 93 MB; distillation 0.401 vs label-only 0.398 (ResNet18, 14.3 M params); 50% channel pruning 0.365 (6.1 M params); 30% channel pruning 0.403 (11.9 M params). Chosen by the declared rule: Pruned 30% + FP16 weights.
